profile.name: Kevil Patel
profile.summary: Associate Software Development Engineer at Kyndryl, working on agentic AI, cloud systems, telemetry pipelines, and observability dashboards.

projects.title: A360
projects.subtitle: Multi-tenant AI agent observability
projects.summary: Kyndryl's multi-tenant AI agent observability platform, with executive dashboards, KPI drill-downs, embedded Kibana, LLM FinOps, and a conversational interface over telemetry.

perspectives.recruiter: Enterprise agent observability work spanning telemetry services and frontend dashboards at Kyndryl.
perspectives.engineer: A360 combines telemetry pipelines, Elasticsearch-backed queries, a FastAPI gateway, and a Next.js frontend with Shidoka.
perspectives.architect: The public architecture describes telemetry moving through OpenTelemetry, Postgres staging, Azure Data Explorer, and Elasticsearch to the frontend.

projects.title: Policy → Pipelines (P2P)
projects.subtitle: Natural-language governance for GCP
projects.summary: A LangGraph platform that turns plain-English policies into compiled constraints, drift detection, risk-scored remediation plans, human-in-the-loop approvals, and audit-ready evidence packs.

perspectives.recruiter: Cloud governance work connecting policy interpretation, remediation review, and audit evidence.
perspectives.engineer: LangGraph and FastAPI support policy compilation and remediation, with React and Vite for the interface and Firestore for evidence packs.
perspectives.architect: Approval-aware execution connects policy, findings, plans, before/after state, and execution logs rather than treating remediation as an unreviewed command.

projects.title: Overlay-Insights
projects.subtitle: Overlay pattern analysis
projects.summary: A Python toolkit for finding repeated overlay patterns across hostnames and analysing business impact through cost and brand value.

perspectives.recruiter: A public analysis toolkit connecting technical patterns with business impact.
perspectives.engineer: Python analysis with an ELK pipeline and Jupyter notebooks.
perspectives.architect: Repeated hostname overlays are the analysis subject; cost and brand value are the stated business-impact dimensions.

projects.title: Incident Ticket Management
projects.subtitle: Script-driven incident analytics
projects.summary: An end-to-end ELK pipeline that cleans, indexes, transforms, and visualises incident-ticket data using reproducible scripts.

perspectives.recruiter: Incident-data processing from cleaning to visualisation.
perspectives.engineer: Script-driven cleaning, indexing, transformation, and visualisation with Python and ELK.
perspectives.architect: A reproducible data pipeline connects incident records to analytics. Engineering question to explore: how should schema changes be managed?

projects.title: IT Asset Analytics
projects.subtitle: Asset-data processing and visualisation
projects.summary: An IT asset analytics pipeline using pandas, NumPy, Elasticsearch, and Kibana for cleaning, indexing, transforming, and visualising asset data.

perspectives.recruiter: A data-engineering project focused on making IT asset data usable for analysis.
perspectives.engineer: pandas and NumPy support data preparation, with Elasticsearch and Kibana for indexing and visualisation.
perspectives.architect: The pipeline covers asset-data preparation through presentation. Engineering question to explore: how should data quality be checked at ingestion?

projects.title: Climate Mitigation Tool
projects.subtitle: Climate-induced migration forecasting
projects.summary: An LSTM multi-modal time-series model for climate-induced migration forecasting using weather data.

perspectives.recruiter: Applied time-series modelling for climate-induced migration forecasting.
perspectives.engineer: The source describes an LSTM multi-modal time-series model and weather API inputs.
perspectives.architect: Engineering question to explore: how should temporal validation and weather-data gaps be handled? The source does not establish those choices.

projects.title: OptiCrop
projects.subtitle: Precision water allocation
projects.summary: Machine learning for precision water allocation in Indian agriculture, built with Python, weather APIs, and rule engines.

perspectives.recruiter: An agriculture-focused project applying machine learning to water allocation.
perspectives.engineer: Python, weather API inputs, and rule engines support the water-allocation use case.
perspectives.architect: Engineering question to explore: how should weather uncertainty affect allocation recommendations? No personal tradeoff decision is established by the source.

projects.title: Smart Energy Forecasting
projects.subtitle: LSTM forecasting on AWS
projects.summary: LSTM energy forecasting using AWS Kinesis, S3, and SageMaker.

perspectives.recruiter: Energy forecasting work combining machine learning and AWS services.
perspectives.engineer: The source names LSTM forecasting with AWS Kinesis, S3, and SageMaker.
perspectives.architect: Engineering question to explore: what evaluation and retraining strategy fits this forecasting workload? A project-specific public artifact is not supplied.

projects.title: Python Essentials
projects.subtitle: A public Python learning guide
projects.summary: A beginner-to-mastery Python guide kept as a public learning artefact and used during GDSC VIT workshops.

perspectives.recruiter: A public learning resource connected to community workshops.
perspectives.engineer: A Python guide intended to support learning from beginner concepts onward.
perspectives.architect: This is an educational artefact, not a claimed production-system architecture.
